title: Add Wholesale – Voice line and grow Enterprise Sales team
story: Sarah, the sales manager, wants a new phone line for wholesale customers. Calls should go to Enterprise Sales so the big deals land with the right group.
She also wants a new owner team called Wholesale Sales Team in the Contoso Sales business unit. The team should have at least four people.
Finally, Sarah asks that Enterprise Sales be staffed up so it has at least eight members in total.
